description: Player 2 deck for spec 29 (R383). This is spec 03 player 2 deck (03-sheepish-b) with #41 Sheepish swapped for C #5 Tesla. Tesla is then the only Trap or Field Trap in either deck, so the face-down card in player 2 backrow can only be Tesla. The deck already holds #62 Friend of Felinors, which fills player 2 unit row in the second test, so that Tesla has no unit zone to step into. Player 1 plays 03-plays-a. The other cards are spec 03 choice-free filler that player 2 never plays. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #8 Mr. Vanilla, #11 Tempo Timmy, #20 Pointmaster and #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, are dealt as stand-ins (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling their numbers as they stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves them.
cards: stand-in (1) 3/3 Rush, First Strike R6/6 Charge, First Strike
stand-in (2) 6/1 Rush, First Strike R12/2 Rush, First Strike, Divine Shield
